<script type="application/javascript">

  var consentDialog = {};
  (function () {
    var self = this;
    var modal = document.getElementById('consent-modal');
    var modalOverlay = document.getElementById('consent-modal-overlay');
    var tabGuardStart = document.getElementById('tab-guard-start');
    var tabGuardEnd = document.getElementById('tab-guard-end');
    var existingUserConsent = document.getElementById('existing-user-consent');
    var newUserConsent = document.getElementById('new-user-consent');
    var deleteConfirmation = document.getElementById('delete-confirmation');
    var pageContent = document.getElementsByClassName('uvPageContainer')[0];
    var currentModal; // Identifies what content is currently being displayed in modal
    var selectedOption; // The option selected by the user.
    var focusPlaceholder; // Used to return focus back to where user left off
    var optionalCallback; // If defined, this will be called when the dialog closes

    self.open = function (newUser, callback) {
      document.body.style.overflowY = 'hidden';
      pageContent.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      modal.style.display = "flex";
      modalOverlay.style.display = "block";

      if (callback) { optionalCallback = callback; }
      focusPlaceholder = document.activeElement;

      if (newUser) {
        showNewUserConsent()
      } else {
        showExistingUserConsent();
      }
    };

    self.close = function () {
      document.body.style.overflowY = 'auto';
      pageContent.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.getElementsByClassName('uvPageContainer')[0].setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      modal.style.display = "none";
      modalOverlay.style.display = "none";

      if (focusPlaceholder) { focusPlaceholder.focus(); }

      if (optionalCallback) { return optionalCallback(selectedOption); }

      return selectedOption;
    };

    self.setExpiration = function (days) {
      var expirationDate = document.getElementById('expiration-date');

      var currentDate = new Date();
      currentDate.setDate(currentDate.getDate() + days);
      var expireDate = currentDate.toLocaleString('en-us', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });

      var numDays = days + ' ' + (days === 1 ? 'day' : 'days');
      expirationDate.innerHTML = ' within ' + numDays + ' (' + expireDate + ')';
    };

    function assignFirstFocusable() {
      var focusable = currentModal.querySelectorAll('a[href], input:not([disabled]), button:not([disabled]), [tabindex="0"]');

      return focusable[0].focus();
    }

    function keepTabFocus(event) {
      var focusable = currentModal.querySelectorAll('a[href], input:not([disabled]), button:not([disabled]), [tabindex="0"]');
      var firstFocusable = focusable[0];
      var lastFocusable = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

      if (document.activeElement === tabGuardStart) {
        event.preventDefault();
        lastFocusable.focus();
      } else if (document.activeElement === tabGuardEnd) {
        event.preventDefault();
        firstFocusable.focus();
      }
    }

    function showExistingUserConsent() {
      var submitAgreement = document.getElementById('submit-agreement');

      submitAgreement.onclick = function () {
        if (selectedOption === 'not_agreed') {
          showDeleteConfirmation();
        } else {
          self.close();
        }
      };

      currentModal = existingUserConsent;
      existingUserConsent.style.display = 'block';
      deleteConfirmation.style.display = 'none';
      assignFirstFocusable();

      initRadioOptions();
    }

    function initRadioOptions() {
      var submitAgreement = document.getElementById('submit-agreement');
      var options = modal.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]');

      for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
        options[i].onclick = function (evt) {
          selectedOption = evt.target.value;
          submitAgreement.disabled = false;
        }
      }
    }

    function showNewUserConsent() {
      var signup = document.getElementById('sign-up');
      var cancel = document.getElementById('sign-up-cancel');

      signup.onclick = function() {
        selectedOption = 'agreed';
        self.close();
      };

      cancel.onclick = function() {
        selectedOption = 'not_agreed';
        self.close();
      };

      currentModal = newUserConsent;
      newUserConsent.style.display = 'block';
      assignFirstFocusable();

      initCheckboxes();
    }

    function initCheckboxes() {
      var signup = document.getElementById('sign-up');
      var checkboxes = Array.prototype.slice.call(modal.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'));
      signup.disabled = checkboxes.length > 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < checkboxes.length; i++) {
        checkboxes[i].onclick = function () {
          signup.disabled = checkboxes.filter(function(c) { return !c.checked }).length > 0;
        }
      }
    }

    function showDeleteConfirmation() {
      var confirmDelete = document.getElementById('profile-delete-confirm');
      var cancelDelete = document.getElementById('profile-delete-cancel');

      currentModal = deleteConfirmation;
      existingUserConsent.style.display = 'none';
      existingUserConsent.active = false;
      deleteConfirmation.style.display = 'block';
      assignFirstFocusable();

      confirmDelete.onclick = function () { self.close(); };
      cancelDelete.onclick = function () { showExistingUserConsent(); };
    }

    document.getElementById('tab-guard-start').onfocus = function(event) { keepTabFocus(event); };
    document.getElementById('tab-guard-end').onfocus = function(event) { keepTabFocus(event); };

  }).apply(consentDialog);

  var consentService = {};
  (function ($) {

    this.deleteUser = function(userId, onSuccess) {
      if (!userId) { return; }
      $.sajax({
        path: '/api/v1/users/' + userId + '?gdpr_consent_declined=true',
        type: 'DELETE',
        success: onSuccess
      });
    };

    this.grantConsent = function(userId, onSuccess) {
      if (!userId) { return; }
      $.sajax({
        path: '/api/v1/users/' + userId + '/grant_gdpr_consent',
        type: 'PUT',
        data: { gdpr_accepted: 'gdpr_accepted' },
        success: onSuccess
      });
    };

    this.recordRequireConsent = function(userId, onSuccess) {
      if (!userId) { return; }
      $.sajax({
        path: '/api/v1/users/' + userId + '/record_requires_gdpr_consent',
        type: 'PUT',
        success: onSuccess
      });
    };

    this.completeAuthGrantConsent = function() {
      var data = {};

        data.accepted_gdpr = true;
        data.accepted_tos = true;

      $.ajax({
        url: '/auth/grant_consent',
        type: 'POST',
        data: data,
        success: function() {
          window.location = '/auth/complete';
        }
      });
    }

    this.completeAuthDeclineConsent = function() {
      window.location = "/auth/cancel_auth";
    }

  }).apply(consentService, [ window.UV.jQuery ]);

  // Broadcast event that consent dialog is available
  window.UV.jQuery(document.body).trigger('consent_dialog_loaded');

        if (response === 'agreed') {
          consentService.grantConsent(user.id);
        } else if (response === 'not_agreed') {
          consentService.deleteUser(user.id, function() { window.location = '/users/deleted'; });

      // Record consent is required and show expiration in dialog
      consentService.recordRequireConsent(user.id, function(response) {
        consentDialog.setExpiration(response.pending_consent_record.expiring_in_days);
      });
    }
  });
